summary.headline: Astrolabes and Planetary Epochs
summary.text: Codices 24–25 describe works on the seven planets, earthquakes, astrolabe techniques, and planetary epochs calculated from Nabonassar’s reign, including the Lion’s heart, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury; codex 26 begins Paul of Alexandria’s introduction to apotelesmatics.
